visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Scene opens in a bright modern kitchen with white cabinets and black handles. A woman with long dark hair tied back, wearing a navy and red raglan long-sleeve shirt and light blue denim jeans with patches, stands by a white counter. She speaks toward the camera, gesturing with her hands while a green pear and a white device sit on the counter. (2) Cut to a living room where a man in a black T-shirt and grey pants walks toward a large red woven bag sitting on a wooden coffee table. A large TV and messy electronic wires are visible in the background against a white wall. He leans over the bag, looking inside with a concentrated expression. (3) View from inside the bag looking up at the man's face as he peers in, his brows furrowed. Then, top-down shots of the bag's interior reveal a chaotic mix of items including a pink Shin-chan toy, a green guava, a large sweet potato, a pink hair clip, and a small pink circular object. (4) The man reaches into the bag, pulls out a white lightbulb and the sweet potato, looking frustrated and confused. The woman enters the frame from the left, looking annoyed and sighing. Both look into the bag which now appears entirely empty except for a red leather pouch and a white chapstick tube. (5) The woman grabs the chapstick, holds it close to the lens with a triumphant, wide-eyed expression, and then walks away into the background. The man leans back over the bag, which is suddenly full of the original random items again. He gestures wildly with his arms and hands in intense confusion.
